name: Tanhyll
ability: Insectivore (its own: its attacks are 4x super effective on Bug types) / Scrappy (hidden)
look: a hunched, shaggy dark-grey anteater on two legs, dappled with lighter grey, a cream bib, a long curved snout with a hooked pink tongue, big curved white claws and a bushy tail
entry: It stands up on its hind legs to tear open Bug Pokémon nests with its huge claws, then slurps up everything inside with its long hooked tongue. Bug Pokémon flee at its very scent.
how: Wild: uncommon in savannas and jungles, rare in forests and badlands.
